ops.title: Adopt the fleet process-cap test harness (AGENTS.md and ci.yml run bare go test)
ops.description: cc-notes ships no scripts/test.sh and no Taskfile; AGENTS.md:128 and :165 both prescribe bare `go test -race -count=1 ./...`, and .github/workflows/ci.yml:27 runs exactly that (plus a bare `-tags webui` run at :169). internal/helperdeployment exercises daemonkit's service and fusekit's holder machinery, i.e. the daemonkit-style self-exec spawn path where bare go test is a fork bomb on a dev machine (daemonkit AGENTS.md, Testing section; 2026-06-24 mount-holder fork-storm incident). Port daemonkit's scripts/test.sh — RLIMIT_NPROC soft cap = uid procs + 400 headroom; note a flat `ulimit -u 500` fails instantly on a machine already carrying ~1000 procs (measured here 2026-07-26: uid procs 1005, cap 1405, hard limit 16000) — and point AGENTS.md, STYLEGUIDE.md, and the CI workflow at it. Found during the helper-plist session-type fix (2026-07-26): every local verification run had to hand-roll the cap formula. Same gap and same fix as cookiesync task 2f8d390, filed 2026-07-26 during the v0.27.3 repin.

ops.text: scripts/test.sh with the RLIMIT_NPROC cap (uid procs + 400) exists and is the documented way to run Go tests
ci.yml routes both the default and -tags webui test steps through the harness
AGENTS.md:128/:165 and STYLEGUIDE.md point at the harness instead of bare go test
